## Change

Describe the user-visible or contract-level change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests passed
- [ ] Full repository checks passed, or exclusions are explained below
- [ ] Build/package output was inspected when applicable
- [ ] Runtime or preview behavior was verified when static checks are insufficient

Evidence (commands, preview/deployment URL, CI run, or artifact):

## Security and privacy

- [ ] The changed diff received a security review, or the reason it is not applicable is recorded
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, production fixtures, prompts, transcripts, or raw tool output were added
- [ ] New permissions, network calls, persistence, destructive behavior, or external services are identified below

## Deployment and rollback

State the deployment boundary, migration/compatibility impact, and rollback path. Write `Not applicable` when appropriate.

## Remaining uncertainty

List unverified behavior and follow-up gates. Do not use a passing unit test as evidence for a runtime, provider, browser, or production claim it did not exercise.
